objective: discover under-recognized transformation stories before the obvious bull run while separately retaining already-rerated companies that have a credible fresh catalyst generation capable of supporting a second major leg

financial_context.principle: use approximately three years of financial history as context, with recent quarters dominating short-horizon inference
financial_context.long_history_role: older than three years is diagnostic only and must not drive the 6-month stock score

pre_obvious_discovery.description: business inflection before the market has fully rerated it

second_leg_reacceleration.description: stock has already rerated materially but a fresh catalyst generation and remaining business upside can support another major leg
second_leg_reacceleration.principle: a previous 50-100% rise is not an automatic rejection; only the portion attributable to the same already-known catalyst remains penalized
